'''Teesoo''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] clan leader from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] who was active during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the end of the [[New Sith Wars]]. Teesoo joined with the influential [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] [[Thrassk]], [[Saya Ksi]] and [[Keekrim Pon]] to re-found the ancient [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] of old as the "New Bounty Hunters Guild," and together, they drafted the [[Bounty Hunters' Creed]], a set of guidelines by which all [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters were expected to abide.<ref name="Files of Boba Fett" />
